description: This is a Java test class for the PurgeExternalEventsTasklet, which tests the behavior of purging external events based on criteria such as age. It includes setup and teardown methods, and tests for successful deletion and exception handling.

classes.name: PurgeExternalEventsTaskletTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing PurgeExternalEventsTasklet's behavior in purging external events.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test context with tenant and action context, creates an instance of PurgeExternalEventsTasklet.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread-local context after each test.

methods.name: givenEventsForPurgeWhenTaskExecutionThenEventsPurgeForDaysCriteria
methods.description: Tests that the task correctly deletes events older than the specified number of days and verifies the criteria used.

methods.name: givenEventsForPurgeWhenExceptionOccursThenJobExecutionFinishesSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests that if an exception occurs during purging, the job finishes successfully with appropriate handling.
